row.notes: Builds the per-car AI behaviour system. In S=[ctl+0x10] pushes BehaviourRace (0x208 B, vt 0x145634ae0), BehaviourRetire (0x145634bd0), BehaviourRecovery (0x145634b60), BehaviourDoughnutCelebration (0x145634a70) into S+0x10, each initialised from DB table "ai.behaviour_system.behaviours" (row = name, vtbl +0x30). BehaviourRace list A +0x1d0: 18 evaluators (vt 0x145634fc0..0x1456387b0, slot 2 calls 0x14065e650); list B +0x1f0: 11 entries vt 0x145635080..0x145635260 (0x145635080 slot 1 = Ai_Apply_TetherSpeedCap 0x140669790). Then ~30 BehaviourTest* objects into [S+0x30] slots (e.g. Alongside 0x145634cb0, Block 0x145634de0, OffsetVariation, HumanAttemptingDivebomb, CedePosition, SpaceSeeking via 0x140655580 at +0x100). Ends by setting game-mode flags on [ctl+0x20]/[ctl+0x28].
